exercises.passage: Omer was the smallest player on his basketball team, and he usually sat on the bench. In the last game of the season, his team was losing by one point, and there were only ten seconds left. Suddenly, their best player hurt his leg. The coach looked at the bench and called Omer's name. Omer's hands were shaking. He got the ball and ran. A tall player stood in front of him, so he passed the ball to his friend Yoni. Yoni missed the shot, but Omer jumped, caught the ball and threw it again. The ball hit the ring, went around it twice, and fell in. Everybody screamed. After the game, the coach told Omer, "You didn't play a lot this year, but you came to every practice. That's why you were ready."
exercises.question: Why did Omer usually sit on the bench?
exercises.explain_he: כתוב: Omer was the smallest player on his team, and he usually sat on the bench.
